title: Devin joins the host picker: 7 cards, real motion
description: The homepage host picker rebuilt as a 21st.dev-derived animated card grid: staggered spring entrance, roving-tabindex arrow-key navigation, reduced-motion support, and a seventh host. Devin's copy is measured, not aspirational: devin plugins install of the #plugins/ork tree lists 76 of 107 skills today; hooks and rules do not load (orchestkit#4146).
